rationale.campaign_length: 43项直接任务分为部族与龙巢两个阶段，目标延伸至中后期。
rationale.colonization: 前期地下探索与殖民明显，后期以征服和属国经营为主。
rationale.complexity: 须同时处理地下扩张、龙兽成长、阶段任务、权威和属国。
rationale.dark_story: 主动征服、强制臣服与制度化资源抽取贯穿帝国阶段。
rationale.difficulty: 骑兵战力强，但附庸与跨区域任务门槛会使长线规划困难。
rationale.diplomacy: 大量附庸、权威与自由渴望构成重要管理环节。
rationale.early_pressure: 初期争夺地下通道和资源，并等待领土与任务门槛。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 核心是驯养龙兽和骑兵，缺少同量级的施法或奇械体系证据。
rationale.narrative_density: 废墟部族、龙兽共生、地底统一和宗主帝国构成连续转折。
rationale.tall_play: 巢穴、矿业与核心区建设重要，但最终需要庞大属国和跨区域领土。
rationale.trade_economy: 战利品、金属与属国资源供给战争，贸易并非专属循环核心。
rationale.warfare: 龙兽神话骑兵、地底要塞战和地表征服是战役主轴。

identity.appearance: 1444年中部蛇脊山脉黑兽人起始国；中段改名龙巢并切换后续任务，保留H73

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 诞生于西山驿的深渊猎手觉醒后留下的伤痕，嚎叫之坑里，我们所骑乘的飞龙出现了。在我们到来之前，这些野兽是蛇脊山脉中部的顶级掠食者，它们是邪恶的生物，天生为战斗而生。它们的红黑色鳞片像钻石一样耐用，它们的身体细长，可以轻松地在石笋之间穿行。它们漆黑的爪子能够撕裂肌肉和骨骼，可以作为工具，抓住并沿着隧道的墙壁跑动。让它们变得更危险的唯一方法是把我们的兽人放在它们身上。骑在这些飞龙身上，我们把最优秀的战士送上战场，造成毁灭性的破坏。当飞龙撕开战线时，兽人完成了那些留在它身上的屠杀，从上方指挥它去寻找下一个目标。
description.text_en: Born from the howling pit within Gor Vazumbrog, the scar left behind by the Hunter of the Deep's awakening, come the great Drakons upon which we ride. These beasts who were the apex predator of the middle Serpentspine, pending our arrival, are vicious creatures, naturally built for battle. Their reddish-black scales are as durable as diamonds, their bodies long and slender to weave between stalagmites with ease. Their pitch-black talons are capable of rending muscle and bone alike, doubling as tools with which to latch onto and run along the walls of the tunnels. The only way to make them more dangerous was to put our orcs upon them. Saddled upon these drakes we put our finest warriors to ride into battle causing devastating damage. As the drake tears through lines the orc finishes those left in its carnage, directing it from above to its next target.

description.text: 在蛇脊山脉的黑暗历史中，人们可能会遇到许多可怕的景象，但很少有人会质疑飞龙骑手是最可怕的。在发光藻类的光芒照耀下，死亡和恐怖的汹涌图像在这些坐骑上蔓延。在一片斑斓色彩的画面中，它们在隧道中飞驰而过。如果你设法避开了这些模糊的光影，那很可能是上面的兽人心血来潮，以便他可以亲自杀死你。
description.text_en: Of the many terrible sights one might encounter among the dark annals of the Serpentspine, few would dispute that a Drakon rider is among the most frightening. Covered in bioluminescent algae, menacing images of death and terror are sprawled across these mounts. In a flurry of colors and pictures, they dash by in the tunnels. Should you manage to avoid this blur of light, it was most likely at the whim of the orc above so that he may get the kill personally.

description.text: 为了模仿他们所骑的飞龙，穿刺飞龙战士已经成功地制造出了铁耙子，他们可以把铁耙子挂在手上，用它来抓墙。就像飞龙可以攀登悬崖一样，现在他们也可以了。爬过墙壁，穿刺飞龙战士能够绕过原本不可攻破的防御。
description.text_en: Emulating the Drakons they ride, the Skewered Drake warriors have managed to fashion iron rakes that they can attach to their hands and latch onto walls with. Much like a Drakon can scale cliffs, now they can too. Climbing over walls, the Skewered Drake warriors are able to bypass defenses otherwise impenetrable.

description.text: 为了烹饪飞龙，人们通常会把它串起来，然后在火上烤，由于它们的体型和肌肉的力量，证明是非常困难的。为了克服这个问题，穿刺飞龙人已经成为磨练和制作大型烤肉串的大师，用来烹调它们和他们遇到的其他野兽。事实上，现在很多兽人在穿越蛇岭时都会随身携带这些烤肉串，在数量上，他们甚至可以直接利用这些烤肉串作为他们所到之处的栅栏来建立营地。
description.text_en: To cook a drake, one often skewers it and roasts its chunks over a fire, proving tremendously difficult due to their size and the strength of their muscles. To overcome this, Skewered Drake have become masters at sharpening and crafting massive skewers to cook them and other beasts they come across. In fact, many orcs of the clan now carry these skewers around with them at all times when out traversing the Serpentspine; in numbers they are able to make camp with them by repurposing these skewers as palisades wherever they go.

description.text: 飞龙的鳞片的坚硬程度是不可低估的，难怪它们会成为如此优秀的工具。飞龙的钻石般坚硬的鳞片可以做成许多东西，如盔甲，但最重要的是做成镐头、锤子和铁锹。这些工具能够开采坚硬的矿石和岩石，如果这些工具出现裂痕或破损，总会在短时间内有更多的鳞片作为补充。
description.text_en: The toughness of a drake's scales can not be understated; it is no wonder then that they would make such excellent tools. A drake's diamond-hard scales can be fashioned into a multitude of things, such as armor, but most importantly into pickaxes, hammers, and shovels. These tools are capable of mining tough ores and rocks, and should these tools ever chip or break there will always be more scales in short time.

description.text: 这是穿刺飞龙酋长们举行的定期体育活动，所谓的「战斗之夜」就是让两个飞龙互相对决，决一死战。为了增加活动的热度，兽人被允许在获胜者身上下注，希望能快速赚取硬币。最后，无论谁赢了比赛或赌注，酋长都能从中分得一杯羹，而氏族也因此变得更加富有。
description.text_en: A regular sporting event held by the chieftains of the Skewered Drake, these so called 'Fight Nights' are where they pit two drakes up against each other in a battle to the death. To add to the fervor of the event, orcs are allowed to bet on the winner in the hopes of making quick coin. In the end, no matter who wins the fight or bets, the chieftain gets a cut of the pool and the clan gets that much richer from it.

description.text: 戈拉思可能被称为愤怒的人，但他不仅仅是个野蛮人，他还非常聪明。他利用废墟上现有的布局来进行有效的管理。正是由于这一点，穿刺飞龙氏族才得以相对轻松地维持了数百年的稳定，而他们在蛇脊山脉中的许多兄弟却失败了。
description.text_en: Gorrath may be known as the Wrathful but he was not merely a brute; he was also tremendously clever, utilizing the existing layout of the ruined hold to administrate efficiently and effectively. It is due to this that the Skewered Drake clan has managed to maintain stability for hundreds of years with relative ease whereas many of their brethren in the Serpentspine have failed.

description.text:
我们的族人只知道流血。战胜我们的敌人，夺走他们的一切，曾经只是为了生存，但现在山中之家和它的财富已为兽人持有。我们将从强者那里夺取，不是因为我们需要，而是因为我们更强大。

蛇脊山脉之外的袭击将由袭击者法典监督，确保囚犯在被赎回之前得到公平对待，禁止攻击尚未完成重建的城镇，并规定那些同意缴纳贡金的人将不会受到攻击。这些规则确保地表人知道我们所求何物，以便他们放弃尽可能多的财富。但更重要的是，它们允许弱者重建并变得更加富有。
一旦他们聚集足够的财富，我们将再次从他们那里夺取一切，因为我们更强大。
description.text_en:
Bloodshed is all our people has ever known. Best our enemies and take everything they have, once merely to survive, but no longer now that the mountain-home and its wealth are orcishkind’s dominion. We will take from the strong, not because we need to, but because we are stronger.

Raids outside the Serpentspine will be overseen by the Algakar Code, which ensures fair treatment of prisoners until they are ransomed, forbids attacks on towns that haven’t finished rebuilding, and states that those who accept to pay tribute shall be left alone. The rules ensure the surfacers know what to expect of us, so that they give up as much riches as possible. But more importantly, they allow the weak to rebuild and grow richer.
And once they gather enough wealth, we will take everything from them too, because we are stronger.

name.text_en: Mountains Don’t Give Back What They Take

description.text:
在矮人之地的黑暗中，商人和探险者需要光，但袭击者在黑暗中潜行。黑皮兽人几个世纪以来发明了许多适应黑暗的战斗技巧，而兽人的统一将这些技巧精炼成一种完全放弃依赖视力的武术。

这种艺术的最伟大的剑师会经历一个仪式，他们挖出自己的眼睛，完全依赖杜坎的视力而不是自己的视力，并成为破链者。即使是其他兽人也害怕这样的高手；他们低声谈论对尚未发起的攻击的看似不可能的反击，谈论一种可怕的不屈不挠的战斗节奏，并相信他们在战斗中不可战胜。
description.text_en:
In the darkness of the Dwarovar, the trader and explorer needs light, but the raider prowls in the dark. Black orcs have invented many fighting techniques adapted to the darkness along the centuries, and the unification of orcishkind has refined them into a martial art of its own that foregoes reliance on sight entirely.

The greatest blademasters of that art undergo a ceremony in which they gouge out their own eyes to rely solely on Dookan’s sight instead of their own, and emerge Unchained. Even other orcs fear such masters; they whisper of seemingly impossible counters to attacks that were not even started, of a terrifying implacable fighting pace and believe them undefeatable in combat.

description.text: 杜坎教导我们，追逐战争而蔑视和平是莽夫，固守和平而畏惧战争则是懦夫。凡事皆有度，真正让我们团结一致的并不仅仅是在战斗中分享的荣耀，也是等待我们回去的家庭，是打开门时妻儿欢迎的笑容。也许总有一天，孩子们也会知晓战争之味，但正如杜坎所教导的那样，凡事都有度，而我们下一代的天真烂漫是乌暗之地真正神圣的珍宝。
description.text_en: Dookan teaches that thinking of war without keeping peace in mind is madness, and that thinking of peace without keeping war in mind is foolishness. There is a time for all things, and what truly keeps us together isn’t the glory we share in battle. It’s the family we come back to, and the smile of a son or daughter welcoming us home. One day, they too shall know war, but as Dookan teaches, there is a time for all things, and nothing is more sacred in Tarakar than a child’s innocence.

description.text:
一切。一个兽人梦寐以求的一切都可以在荣誉决斗中获得，只要他确保自己有足够的力量。这就是兽人荣誉决斗的每个参与者都默认的非正式规则。

尽管如此，即使是兽人也会在荣誉决斗非胜即死的残酷面前心生疑虑，除非是没有什么东西可失去的亡命之徒，否则很少有兽人会轻易发起一次荣誉决斗；此外，极高的死亡率也起不到磨练国内兽人战士武技的作用。我们将用仪式化的角斗取代过去为解决争端而进行的荣誉决斗，以保持我们的勇武。任何想要获得更高的地位、更多的财富或更大的名声的战士都可以进入竞技场，用自己的血肉和拳头赢得它，而最后一个能在战斗结束后还站着的——即使是一个靠狡猾取胜的矮人，或罕见地有武者精神与荣誉感的古怪地精——也能够得到胜者应有的待遇，这就是唯一的规则。这就是我们兽人的生活方式，也是唯一真实的生活方式。
description.text_en:
Everything. Everything one desires can be acquired in an Ozarm’chadash, ensuring he has the strength to claim it. Such is the informal rule of those duels the participants implicitly agree on.

Still, the nature of such a challenge makes people wary of issuing them unless they have nothing left to lose, and they don’t hone our people’s skills as much as they could. We will replace those duels of honor to settle disputes by ritualized gladiatorial combats to keep us strong. Anyone who wishes to acquire greater status, wealth, or fame can enter the arena to claim it, and the last one standing -even should it be a mean enough dwarf or the odd honorable goblin- will have earned it by right of strength, the only one that matters. Such is the way we orcs live by, and the only true way.

description.text:
「—看来你的地图是正确的，穆什。我们从这儿弄到了不少财宝。现在看来这群胡须矮子真的不像以前那么会制造东西了。
—我经常思考这一点。『哲学家』穆什回答道，其他兽人这么称呼他是有原因的。矮子们之所以分崩离析，就是因为他们挖掘了那堆巨大的大厅，并制作了一堆大雕像来填充这些大厅。
—你的话好像没什么逻辑。
—他们的举动充满了自我主义。想要被万世记住，却只建造了自己的坟冢。而我们将用这些东西工作，不会让它们放在那里落灰。
—呃，我从来没有这么想过。我猜这就是他们管你叫哲学家的原因。
—记住，我们正在为我们拿回的每一件作品赋予新的生命。我们不仅仅是拾荒者。我们是未来的建设者。
—行行行，好好好，未来先放在一边吧。这些碎块真够重的。」

在干活时，格拉克忍不住想要知道穆什的话是否属实。也许，他们不仅仅是拾荒者。也许，只是也许，他们会是更伟大事物的一部分。
description.text_en:
“-That map of yours was right, Mushû. Tons of good salvage in there. The bearded really don’t make stuff as they used to.
-I think of that often, answered Mushû the Philosopher, because they called him that for a reason. They fell apart because of all those giant halls they dug and giant statues they made to fill them.
-You ain’t making any sense.
-They were full of themselves. Wanted to be remembered, but only built their own tomb instead. We’ll make something out of it, and it’s going to be used by our people and not sitting there looking fancy.
-Uh, never thought of it like that. Guess that’s why they call you the Philosopher.
-Just remember, we’re giving new life to every piece we take back. We’re not just scavengers. We’re builders of the future.
-Yeah, well, the future can wait a bit. These pieces are heavy.”

As they got to work, Gralk couldn't help but wonder if there was some truth to Mushû's words. Maybe they were more than just scavengers. Maybe, just maybe, they were part of something bigger.

description.text:
想要成为乌暗之地的统治者，首要条件就是粉碎挡在自己面前的一切障碍。统治乌暗之地与不可挑战的统治之间可以划上等号。兽人们过去也许追随过自己同乡的首领，但现在只有一个足够强大的领袖，值得山脉之中所有兽人服从。

我们的国度本身将确立这一真理，并将争吵不休的部落锻造成某些更新、更强的事物。在伸手不见五指的洞穴中洒下的鲜血，以及蛇脊山脉锻炉的烈火中，一个真正的兽人国家将会最终浮现。
description.text_en:
To become Tarakar’s ruler, one must destroy all obstacles on their way. To rule Tarakar is to rule unchallenged. Orcs may once have followed local chiefs, but there is now only one being strong enough to be worth following under the mountains.

Our realm itself shall acknowledge that truth, and from bickering tribes something new, something stronger will be forged. Out of the blood spilt in unseen caverns and the fire of the Serpentspine’s forges, a true nation of orcs will emerge.

description.text:
我们兽人拥有杜坎本尊馈赠的「火花」，祂将神性分给了我们自己。这是一份馈赠，也是一种责任，我们有义务帮助杜坎摆脱其余背信弃义的诸神对祂施与的不公囚禁，只因他想为自己和我们找到一个新的家园。

然而，这一故事的诸多变体在整个蛇脊山脉中流传。我们将致力于将这些传说编纂并正式化，创建杜坎真正且统一的教义，兽人学家将会成为乌暗之地的战士，在适合的场合大展身手！毕竟，解救一位神不是只靠肉体凡胎和钢铁就能完成的任务；让背叛之神们的追随者弃祂们而去，削弱祂们的力量，增强拯救杜坎的力量。到了那时，祂们的背信弃义都将被悉数清算！
description.text_en:
We orcs hold within us the spark legated by Dookan himself, his divinity our own. A gift, but also a duty to free him from the unjust imprisonment inflicted upon him by the treacherous other gods as he wanted to find a new home for himself and us.

However, numerous variations of the story can be found all across the Serpentspine. We will work on compiling them and creating a unified version of the true teachings of Dookan, and orcish scholars will become Tarakar’s warriors in the greatest of all conflicts! Freeing a god is not a task that can be achieved by mortal steel; Dookan’s cage shall be broken by making the followers of the traitor gods turn away from them to weaken their power. Only then shall their treachery be undone!

player_overview.how_it_plays: 先在地下殖民和夺取要塞，以掠夺供养龙骑兵；中期发展巢穴与矿业，改革为龙巢领地；后期管理大量属国并进行跨区域征服。
player_overview.overview: 你从中部蛇脊山脉的黑兽人部族出发，与龙兽伙伴一同争夺矮人要塞和地底道路。完成前段征服后，国家改名龙巢，转向经营权威、附庸、矿业和龙兽军队，并向布勒瓦尔及更远地区扩张。
player_overview.recommended_for: 适合喜欢特殊骑兵、黑兽人、地下探险、长期扩张和附庸帝国经营的玩家。
signature_features: 与龙兽共战的神话骑兵和首领坐骑成长，让骑兵成为战役主角。
前后两阶段任务把掠夺部族转成保留原Tag的附庸帝国。
专属权威可征召劳力、抽取属国资源和举行竞技大会，强制索取会增加统治成本。
player_overview.tagline: 驯养龙兽、纵横地下，再以骑兵和附庸国建立龙巢帝国。

values.rationale: 强制臣服、属国劳力与发展抽取构成真实压迫，但严重度低于奴隶制、人口资源化或灭绝。现有部分劳力互动的实际执行细节仍需实机确认，因此不应按旧模型压到极低价值区。
